verdict: Organic traffic is up; paid campaigns and key milestones need to launch.
narrative: Your site saw a 21.56% week-over-week increase in traffic with zero paid spend behind it, which speaks to real organic demand — but that momentum is already beginning to soften without a paid driver to sustain it. No ads ran on Meta or Google this period, meaning there is no ecommerce purchase or return-on-ad-spend data to report. Several planned milestones — including the pre-launch gate, funnel test, and SEO guardrails — were due August 31st and are being pushed through now to get the program on track. Once paid campaigns are live and the Shopify purchase tracking repair is confirmed, you'll have a complete picture of what your site traffic is actually converting into revenue.
